description: Pierce County, Washington publishes this geospatial resource. Coverage is the county or the specific subarea named below. The 2000 and 2010 urban federal-highway boundaries define population-based areas used for highway growth planning and design standards. The native layers expose polygon geometry and named attributes, including OBJECTID_1, NAME, Class, YEAR. It provides source-defined infrastructure geometry, constraints or measurements for capacity planning studies. The two dated editions form one historical planning-boundary resource; neither is a road network or a claim about current urban limits. The public county catalogue advertises ArcGIS REST access and export descriptors such as GeoJSON, CSV and shapefile. Public metadata access was verified; no feature query or file download was performed. Reuse is subject to county terms linked by the provider; the PDF terms were not read, so no open licence or unrestricted reuse is assumed. Charges are not stated. Metadata modification dates do not establish observation dates, and a regular update schedule is not stated. No directly related active record was confirmed for this resource.
